subject: Aria Labs: Request for tenant-isolation carveout + limited runbook access
messages:
From: Haley Ruiz <haley@arialabs.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2025-05-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private deployment ask: audit window + tenant isolation

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo — Aria's engineering and security team are aligned on moving forward but we have two non-standard asks that will need explicit approvals from Redwood leadership and Deal Desk before we escalate to legal:

1) Tenant isolation carveout: due to regulatory guidance from our customers, we need a confirmed tenant isolation model (single-tenant VPC) for the initial pilot and a limited window (2 weeks per quarter) where our on-call ops can request emergency access for forensics. We understand there are costs and operational implications.

2) Short audit-forensics window: we need a guaranteed 7-day forensics window for data retention and a 48-hour on-call response SLA for audit log requests during that window.

We can accept a limited set of runbook access — read-only runbook plus a documented emergency escalation path — but this will require a contractual carveout and a small onboarding discount to offset the extra ops cost. Can you outline the approval path and whether this is something Deal Desk + an exec OK can approve?

Attachments: Aria_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (security responses), proposed-MAP-v1.xlsx (pilot scope).

Haley Ruiz
Head of IT Security, Aria Labs
haley@arialabs.com
+1 415-555-0199
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: Haley Ruiz <haley@arialabs.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2025-05-17T10:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment ask: audit window + tenant isolation

Haley — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments.

We can support single-tenant VPC pilots and a documented emergency access flow, but both require an operational carveout and approval from our Deal Desk and an exec-level sign-off for the limited runbook access and shortened SLA.

I've looped in Jordan (Sales Deal Desk) to confirm pricing and Kimberly (Enterprise Ops lead) for the ops constraints. I'll surface the key asks to Deal Desk today and include the Aria attachments. Expect a proposed plan and an approval ask by EOD tomorrow.

Grace O'Connor
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com

Subject: Exec approval needed: Aria Labs - tenant isolation + 2-week quarterly access window (Deal DL-2025-ARIA-078)

Kimberly / Markus —

Heads-up on a mid-size pilot (Aria Labs, Deal DL-2025-ARIA-078). They require:

- Single-tenant VPC for initial pilot (30-90 days)
- A 2-week, timeboxed ops access window per quarter for their on-call team to run forensics (read-only unless emergency).
- Contracted 7-day forensics retention window and 48-hour response SLA for audit log requests during that window.
- Aria is asking for a 10% onboarding discount to cover setup/config overhead.

Operational impact / risk notes from Engineering Ops (Kimberly):
- We can implement tenant isolation for the pilot but will need a staffed on-call rotation and modified runbook that limits write privileges. That increases monthly ops cost ~ $12k for the pilot period.
- The 2-week quarterly window and 48-hour log access SLA require us to guarantee dedicated storage for retention and a staffed escalation path. This is feasible but not standard.

Requested approvals:
1) Exec OK to permit non-standard runbook carveout (read-only access + emergency write path) for the pilot.
2) Discount approval: up to 10% onboarding credit to offset ops setup (or equivalent one-time credit).
3) Agreement that Deal Desk can sign the SOW with the carveouts documented and Legal will handle narrow contract language.

Attachments included in the Deal record: Aria_Security_Questionnaire.pdf, proposed-MAP-v1.xlsx

Grace — please add any customer context. Aria is comfortable with a short-term pilot and could expand to Dedicated capacity if the pilot succeeds.

-Jordan
Jordan Blake
Deal Desk, Redwood Inference
From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2025-05-20T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec approval needed: Aria Labs - tenant isolation + 2-week quarterly access window (Deal DL-2025-ARIA-078)

Team — after reviewing the ask and Kimberly's cost estimate, I approve the following for the Aria pilot:

1) Approve single-tenant VPC pilot with a documented emergency escalation path. Runbook access will be read-only by default; emergency write access requires a two-person authorization and will be limited to the defined 2-week quarterly windows unless otherwise escalated.

2) Approve a one-time onboarding credit of 10% (applied to the onboarding invoice) to offset ops setup.

3) Deal Desk may proceed to finalize the SOW with Legal. Include explicit limits on the forensics window, the 48-hour log response SLA, and a clause requiring Aria to notify Redwood 30 days in advance of any forensic investigations that fall outside the agreed windows.

Please route the amended SOW to Legal for precise language and notify Aria of the approved terms. Grace, can you coordinate the customer notification and schedule a short alignment call with Aria's Security team and Kimberly's Ops lead on Monday?

-Markus Klein
VP, Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com
